physical: Momentum is conserved in every collision; kinetic energy is conserved in an elastic collision and partly converted to internal energy in an inelastic one, the fraction set by the coefficient of restitution.
reflected_sentence: The conservation keeps: momentum stays through every meeting, while a motion-energy stays only when the meeting gives the rates back and is partly changed when it does not, by a ratio of rates.
rule_reason: Conservation law; cost block empty, so the relationship keeps.
interpretation: The form is a conservation, so the relationship keeps. momentum is the frozen partner. No frozen word names the motion-energy or the ratio of rates, and conscious energy is not substituted.
closing: Both clauses are conservation statements and the cost block is empty, so the relationship keeps. The restitution ratio does not carry resistance and was not treated as a cost. Kinetic energy was not mapped to conscious energy, because the table names physical energy, not kinetic energy. No new word was introduced.
